_summary: 15 returns-bearing entries (12 cases) included, 6 skipped. Every engine-vs-Lean difference is either the Tax Table vs rate-schedule method (<= $5), §72(t) not computed by the engines, or the tcsumm-2024-12 QBI omission, where both engines are right and the encoding is missing §199A: with it Lean matches the court exactly for 2018 and 2019. No genuine Lean statutory error found.
